overview: jfnc’s FRM-like/1 source starts z from pixel and state from seed. Each loop squares z and adds state, then advances state by drift times transform(state). The orbit remains while |z| <= 4.
mathSummary: init: z = pixel; state = seed. loop: z = sqr(z) + state; state = state + drift * transform(state). bailout: |z| <= 4.

sourceWalkthrough.explanation: This initialization assignment sets state = seed; z was initialized separately from pixel.
This loop assignment sets z = sqr(z) + state using the current state.
This assignment advances state to state + drift * transform(state) after z has been updated.
The bailout comparison accepts the orbit while |z| <= 4.

syntaxFeatures.explanation: The z update reads the current state, whereas the following assignment changes state through drift and transform.

steps: Use seed = 0 + 0i, drift = 0 + 0i, and transform = identity at the pinned profile. Keeping all controls fixed, change only seed to 1 + 0i and render; restore it, then change only drift to 1 + 0i and render; restore it, then change only transform to sqr and render.
